meta.name: handoff
meta.description: Compact the current conversation into a handoff document for another agent to pick up.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将当前对话压缩为交接文档，供其他智能体继续处理
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个智能体之间传递对话上下文
copy.tagline_en: Compact the current conversation into a handoff document for another agent
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to pass conversation context between multiple agents

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会将当前对话压缩成一份交接文档，供另一个 AI 继续工作。文档会包含对话摘要、建议调用的技能列表，并引用已有的设计文档、计划等，不重复内容。
howto.when: 当你需要把当前任务交给另一个 AI 继续处理时，可以要求 Claude 生成交接文档。

say.text: 帮我生成一份交接文档，下一个会话要接着做用户注册功能。
say.note: Claude 会生成包含摘要和技能建议的文档。

say.text: 把当前对话整理成 handoff 文档，重点放在数据库设计上。
say.note: 文档会聚焦你指定的方向。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude compresses the current conversation into a handoff document for another agent to continue. It includes a summary, suggested skills, and references to existing artifacts without duplicating content.
howto.when_en: When you need to hand off the current task to another agent, ask Claude to generate a handoff document.

say_en.text: Generate a handoff document for the next session to continue the user registration feature.
say_en.note: Claude creates a document with summary and skill suggestions.

say_en.text: Summarize this conversation into a handoff doc focusing on database design.
say_en.note: The document will be tailored to your focus.
